modules.name: Layer manifest and provenance schema
modules.design_question: What single manifest lets any module find, verify, cache, credit and datum-check a layer without opening the data?
modules.method: Extend Vista's release-manifest (format, file_count, total_bytes, per-file bytes and sha256; seen in the local repo) into manifest.json 'vcm-layers/1'. One record per layer: id, title, theme, version; source {publisher, dataset_id, url, retrieved, source_modified}; licence {id, attribution, share_alike, redistribution}; crs {horizontal EPSG, vertical {datum, epsg|null, z_offset_m, basis}}; geometry; lod (Biljecki 2016 names, e.g. LOD1.2); accuracy {h_m, v_m, basis}; bbox; count; fields; files [{path, role, format, bytes, sha256, content_type, range_safe}]; derived_from; build {script, commit}; modules_using; status. Publish a JSON Schema. CI validator rejects: missing licence or datum; sha256 or byte mismatch; file over cap; an ODbL layer inside derived_from of a non-ODbL layer; a range-read format with range_safe false. Modules declare requires:[layer ids] so the registry computes what to fetch. Provenance rule: every coordinate and height traces to a survey or open-data file; no value is generated by a language model (GPT-6 Astra may draft code and text only).
modules.human_judgment: Decide which layers ship in the core bundle versus optional; confirm attribution wording and datum statements with each publisher.

modules.name: Storage formats and tiling
modules.design_question: Which format and tiling per layer minimises bytes yet lets the browser load only what the current view needs?
modules.method: Choose format by access pattern. Points and tables (trees 184,268; heritage 2,495; stations 22; parcel and tax attributes): GeoParquet 1.1, zstd, Hilbert-sorted, bbox covering column, 10-50k-row groups, read with hyparquet. Display polygons (parcels 99,698; footprints 154,124; zoning 1,621; parks 254): PMTiles v3 MVT, about z10-z16 with overzoom, attributes height_m and base_m; keep the same data as GeoParquet for analysis. LOD1: store footprint + height_m + base_m only, never baked meshes; MapLibre fill-extrusion takes height and base in metres. Mark LOD1.3 where podium and tower tops differ by more than about 2 m. Terrain and canopy rasters: quantised elevations (uint16 decimetres or uint8 half-metres) as WebP/PNG tiles in PMTiles, or COG; datum in manifest. Hand-modelled meshes (landmarks, mountain backdrop): glTF + KHR_mesh_quantization + EXT_meshopt_compression. 3D Tiles only if Cesium is adopted or features exceed about 1M; its heights are ellipsoidal. View cones: analytic parameters, not meshes. Point clouds: link NRCan COPC, never mirror. 2D CRS EPSG:4326; metric work EPSG:3157. Publish a measured size table before committing any layer.
modules.human_judgment: Choose which layers need analysis-grade geometry (Parquet) versus display-only tiles, and accept lossy simplification for far context buildings.

modules.name: GitHub hosting, size budgets and range/compression
modules.design_question: How do we host a multi-layer open dataset within GitHub limits while keeping range-read formats working in browsers?
modules.method: Limits (docs): Pages site 1 GB, source repo 1 GB recommended, bandwidth soft 100 GB/month, 10 builds/hour soft; git warns at 50 MiB, blocks at 100 MiB; releases 2 GiB per file, 1,000 assets, no total cap; LFS free 10 GiB storage and bandwidth, unusable with Pages. Measured 21 Oct 2026 on the team's Pages site: 206 with Content-Range, Access-Control-Allow-Origin * and Cache-Control max-age=600; but application/octet-stream and JSON are gzip-encoded, so a browser Range request returns gzip-stream bytes (unified_buildings.bin: total 2,383,874 vs raw 9,722,568). Images are not encoded. jsDelivr brotli-encodes and caps GitHub files at 20 MB. Release downloads send no CORS header. Therefore: (1) build data in CI and deploy with upload-pages-artifact so git history stays small; (2) archive each snapshot as a release zip for citation; (3) before relying on PMTiles/Parquet/FGB range reads, deploy a one-file probe per extension and require 206 plus magic bytes under Accept-Encoding gzip; (4) default to whole-file GETs of files up to 20 MB, which gzip handles; (5) fallback: shard layers into 1 km cells or use a CORS-enabled object store.
modules.human_judgment: Decide whether a CORS-enabled object store is acceptable if probes fail, since it adds an account and possible cost.

Measured HTTP behaviour of the team's Pages site

modules.name: Local cache and layer subscription
modules.design_question: How do tools subscribe to layers, stay fresh as open data changes, and work offline with minimal bandwidth?
modules.method: Subscription is manifest plus versions. The client fetches manifest.json (Pages caches 10 minutes), compares each layer's version and sha256 with its cache, and downloads only changed files. Browser cache: Cache Storage or OPFS keyed by sha256; keep current and previous version. Desktop/Python: %LOCALAPPDATA%/vancouver-context/<layer>/<version>/ with the same manifest and a lock file. Modules call registry.require(['cov-public-trees']) and receive a handle plus attribution; they re-render on a layer-updated event. Refresh follows source cadence: City trees weekdays, parcels, zoning and tax weekly (portal text), heritage annual (last modified 2023-03-24), LiDAR and 2015 footprints static. A weekly GitHub Action reads each portal dataset's data_processed field, rebuilds only changed layers, runs the validator and deploys. Offline mode serves cached layers and shows source dates. Optional live fallback: City portal exports send Access-Control-Allow-Origin * (HEAD-tested for parquet, geojson, csv, fgb), but rate limits are unverified, so never depend on them at runtime.
modules.human_judgment: Set refresh policy per layer and decide whether students may enable live portal fallback.

modules.name: Licence, attribution and share-alike
modules.design_question: Which licence and attribution does each layer carry, and how do we keep ODbL share-alike from spreading to other layers?
modules.method: Licence register keyed by layer. OGL-Vancouver, OGL-BC v2.0 and OGL-Canada v2.0 allow commercial use, modification and redistribution with attribution; default statement 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Vancouver / British Columbia / Canada'; exclusions: personal information, third-party rights, official marks; no endorsement. Metro Vancouver items state 'Open Government Licence, Metro Vancouver Open Data Portal' (text not read); one raster record says 'custom'. OSM and Overture buildings are ODbL: attribution and share-alike. Follow the OSMF Collective Database guideline: per feature type and region, data is all-OSM or all-non-OSM, with no cross-references; otherwise treat the merged layer as ODbL. Keep ODbL layers in separate files flagged share_alike=true; rendered PNG/PDF are Produced Works but the database must be available. Do not merge OSM heights into City footprints. TransLink data is permission-based, needs a legend and is revocable: fetch optionally, do not mirror. BC Assessment bulk data is not open: use the City property tax report. Repo: code MIT or Apache-2.0; data licence per layer; NOTICE generated from the manifest.
modules.human_judgment: Ask the City and Metro Vancouver to confirm attribution wording; decide whether to include any ODbL layer at all.

modules.name: Vertical datum and CRS registry
modules.design_question: How do heights from CGVD28GVRD, CGVD2013, EGM96 and ellipsoid layers stay comparable for cone and airspace tests?
modules.method: Every z-bearing file declares z_ref. Known: City LiDAR 2022 CGVD28GVRD (Metro Vancouver geoid HTMVBC00; BC calls CGVD28 its current datum); NRCan HRDEM and CanElevation CGVD2013 (NAD83(CSRS) epoch 2010); Vista SRTM EGM96; 3D Tiles WGS84 ellipsoid; City 2013 DEM not stated; view cones 'geodetic height' (datum unconfirmed); YVR surfaces 'above sea level' (datum unconfirmed). EPSG: 5713 CGVD28 height, 6647 CGVD2013(CGG2013) height, 4979 WGS84 3D, 3157 UTM 10N. NRCan's preliminary table gives CGVD2013 minus CGVD28 = +15 cm at Vancouver (HTv2.0 vs CGG2010; local HTMVBC00 may differ). The registry stores z_offset_m to a chosen canonical datum plus uncertainty; transformations apply on load, never inside source-derived files. The canonical datum is a parameter, set after confirming the cone-height datum with the City; until then every cone result carries a 'cone datum unconfirmed' flag. Grid-derived offsets replace the 0.15 m placeholder.
modules.human_judgment: Confirm with the City which datum cone heights use before choosing the canonical datum.

modules.name: Trees and canopy layers
modules.design_question: How do we store street trees and canopy compactly while stating height and crown uncertainty honestly?
modules.method: Trees: build cov-public-trees from the portal Parquet export. Keep asset_id, genus/species dictionary ids, diameter_cm (uint16, 0.1 cm), height class and position (0.1 m, EPSG:3157). height_m has 84 distinct values but ten classes hold 95.6% of trees (4.6, 7.6, 10.7, 13.7, 16.8, 19.8, 22.9, 25.9, 29.0, 32.0 m). These equal 15 to 105 ft in 10 ft steps, so treat them as class midpoints (inference), uncertainty about plus or minus 1.5 m. Crown width is not supplied: estimate from diameter and genus (team assumption; calibrate against LiDAR). Canopy: derive a canopy height model from City LiDAR 2022 (class 4 high vegetation, DSM minus DTM) at 2 m, stored as uint8 half-metre tiles; keep Metro Vancouver 2020 5 m land cover (tree accuracy 80% deciduous, 94% coniferous) as regional cross-check. Private trees exist only in the CHM. Output tree instances for shading and sky-view, plus a canopy raster for sun and heat studies. Instance one low-poly crown per genus; no per-tree meshes.
modules.human_judgment: Decide the acceptable crown model and whether to request City canopy polygons.

modules.name: Future layers: land value, zoning, heritage, transit, traffic, airspace, shadow
modules.design_question: How do land value, zoning, heritage, transit, traffic, airspace and shadow-sensitive spaces plug into the store without new geometry?
modules.method: Store each future layer as attribute-light tables keyed to existing geometry. Land value: parcel tax_coord equals tax-report land_coordinate (first 8 folio digits); site_id equals PID without dashes (checked at 1030 W Georgia St). Keep only the latest report_year (2026: 228,935 rows) and current_land_value, current_improvement_value, year_built, zoning_district as uint32 and dictionary columns in the parcel layer; strata folios may share one polygon (unverified), so aggregate. Zoning: 1,621 polygons, no height field; keep zoning_district, cd_1_number. Heritage: 2,495 points; keep category, evaluationgroup, status. Transit: City stations (22) now; TransLink GTFS optional. Traffic: the portal holds only count locations (659 intersections; 6,680 directional lines, 2004-2013); volumes sit behind VanMap links, so store locations and mark volumes unresolved. Airport: generate YVR surfaces analytically from SOR/80-902 (outer surface 45 m above ARP elevation of 2 m, about 47 m by calculation; approach slope 1:50; transitional 1:7); no official GIS. Shadow-sensitive spaces: parks (254) and schools (194) plus rule parameters (proposed 10:00-16:00 PDT equinox window, unconfirmed).
modules.human_judgment: Order the layers by Tall Challenge needs; confirm YVR surfaces with Transport Canada.
inputs: City parcels, tax report, zoning, heritage, stations, parks, schools
TransLink GTFS (optional)
SOR/80-902 schedule
Park Board and Council solar-access material (unopened)
outputs: Shadow-sensitive space table with rule parameters

sources.title: OGL-Vancouver text as reproduced in OSM help thread
sources.extract: Licence based on OGL-BC 2.0; commercial use allowed; default attribution 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Vancouver'; thread reaches no ODbL conclusion.

sources.title: Open Government Licence - British Columbia v2.0
sources.extract: Worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual use incl. commercial; attribution statement required; exclusions: personal information, third-party rights, official marks.

sources.title: Open Government Licence - Canada v2.0
sources.extract: Commercial use, copying, modification and distribution allowed; standard attribution statement for multiple sources; exclusions as OGL-BC.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap copyright and licence
sources.extract: Data under ODbL; credit required; if you alter or build upon the data you may distribute the result only under the same licence.

sources.title: OSMF Collective Database Guideline
sources.extract: Endorsed 17 June 2016. Independent when each data type in a regional cut is all OSM or all non-OSM and datasets do not reference each other.

sources.title: OSMF Horizontal Map Layers guideline
sources.extract: Overlaying OSM with non-OSM layers needs no sharing if each feature type is wholly non-OSM; same feature type from both requires sharing.

sources.title: OSMF Produced Work guideline
sources.extract: PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG images are usually Produced Works; database dumps are not; publishing a Produced Work requires the underlying database be available.

sources.title: GitHub Pages limits
sources.extract: Site no larger than 1 GB; source repo 1 GB recommended; soft 100 GB/month bandwidth; soft 10 builds/hour; 10-minute deploy timeout.

sources.title: About large files on GitHub
sources.extract: Warning above 50 MiB; blocked above 100 MiB; repos under 1 GB where possible, under 5 GB strongly recommended; releases have no total size limit.

sources.title: About Git Large File Storage
sources.extract: Per-file maximum 2 GB Free/Pro, 4 GB Team, 5 GB Enterprise; Git LFS cannot be used with GitHub Pages sites.

sources.title: Git LFS billing
sources.extract: Free plan 10 GiB bandwidth and 10 GiB storage; forking and pulling count against the parent's bandwidth; over quota disables LFS or blocks pushes.

sources.title: About releases
sources.extract: Each release file under 2 GiB; up to 1,000 assets per release; no limit on total release size or bandwidth; CORS not mentioned.

sources.title: PMTiles v3 specification
sources.extract: 127-byte header; root directory within first 16 KiB; tile types MVT, PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF; gzip, brotli or zstd compression; Hilbert tile ids.

sources.title: GeoParquet 1.1.0
sources.extract: WKB or native GeoArrow encodings; PROJJSON CRS defaulting to OGC:CRS84; bbox covering columns for spatial filtering; Z coordinates allowed; vertical datums not addressed.

sources.title: FlatGeobuf
sources.extract: Packed Hilbert R-tree index; HTTP range access; read-only; BSD 2-Clause; compression not part of format; Z support and CRS not stated on page.

sources.title: 3D Tiles 1.1 specification
sources.extract: glTF content; implicit tiling; region volumes in radians with heights in metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid; legacy b3dm and i3dm deprecated.

sources.title: EXT_meshopt_compression
sources.extract: Ratified glTF extension compressing bufferView data; modes for attributes and indices; works with KHR_mesh_quantization; no fixed ratios stated.

flags.detail: Current schema has height_m and diameter_cm doubles; no height_range_id.
flags.correction: Use height_m, but treat as class midpoints: 84 values, ten classes hold 95.6%.

flags.claim: GitHub Pages serves any file with usable range requests
flags.detail: application/octet-stream and JSON are gzip-encoded; browser range requests return gzip-stream bytes.
flags.correction: Probe every extension; default to whole-file GETs up to 20 MB; shard or use another host if probes fail.

flags.claim: Release assets can feed the browser viewer
flags.detail: Neither the 302 hop nor the final asset host returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
flags.correction: Use releases for archives and CI; serve browser data from Pages.

flags.claim: Git LFS can hold Pages data

flags.correction: Build in CI and deploy by artifact; no LFS.

flags.detail: Portal licence page is script-rendered; wording taken from a 2017 forum post.

flags.claim: .parquet, .pmtiles, .fgb files get no gzip on Pages

Gzip behaviour of .parquet, .pmtiles, .fgb, .zip on Pages: searched github.io samples, found none; needs probe.
City mid-block traffic volumes: 200-dataset listing and City traffic page (403) show only location indices and VanMap links.
BC MoTI current AADT licence and download: CKAN queries returned no dataset except Annual Traffic Volumes 2004-2010 (xlsx, OGL-BC).
City canopy raster or polygons: none in portal; 2022 canopy assessment PDF and Park Board solar memo returned 403.
LidarBC Metro Vancouver and North Shore tile datum and vintage: catalogue record names licence only.
EPSG code and Vancouver conversion grid for CGVD28GVRD to CGVD2013: HTMVBC00 not downloaded; +0.15 m is preliminary.
Metro Vancouver licence full text and CRS of the land cover tif: not read.
Whether strata folios share one City parcel polygon and the parcel-tax join rate: not measured.
Compressed sizes of derived layers and City portal rate limits: unmeasured.
change_log: Replaced assumed height-range tree field with measured height_m class structure (84 values, ten classes 95.6%).
Added empirical finding that Pages gzip breaks range reads for octet-stream and JSON; added probe gate and whole-file default.
Excluded release assets and LFS from browser delivery after CORS and Pages tests.
Replaced BC Assessment with City property tax report plus verified parcel join at 1030 W Georgia.
Added vertical-datum registry module after finding CGVD28GVRD, CGVD2013, EGM96 and ellipsoid layers.
Marked TransLink permission-based and Overture/OSM ODbL; added separation rule.
Added verified City metadata, counts and dates for 14 portal datasets and Metro Vancouver, NRCan, BC and YVR records.
notes: vancouver.ca, guidelines.vancouver.ca and council.vancouver.ca returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch; I did not bypass this. Byte sizes for derived layers are estimates, not measurements.
